Build me a Python tool that turns a GitHub repository into a readable Markdown context snapshot I can give an LLM. Let me supply a repository URL, optionally a branch and subfolder, choose file extensions and a per-file line limit, and get repository metadata, dependency summaries, a directory tree and selected text-file contents in deterministic order. Respect .gitignore and common generated/dependency directories, don't include secret environment files by default, skip non-text files, and clearly identify truncated files instead of making the snapshot look complete. Support private repositories with a token kept out of the output, show a useful error when cloning or reading fails, and clean up temporary checkouts even after failure. Give me a CLI and a simple local Streamlit page for generating and downloading the same snapshot; no hosted service is necessary. Keep the core independent of the UI so it can be checked with a small local fixture repository instead of real network requests.

messages.content:
## Decisions and unresolved questions

Proposed decisions:

- Support simple branch names in tree URLs; do not guess slash-containing branch names.
- A positive line limit truncates; zero means unlimited. Exclude environment files and symlinks.
- CLI and UI controllers delegate to the same snapshot operation.

Unresolved/nonessential choices:
- Slash-containing branch names need a separate branch argument or an unambiguous future URL syntax.

## Proposed interface agreement

Proposed public helpers `repo_context.core` plus a shared facade `context_workflow`:
- `parse_github_url(url)` -> (canonical .git URL,branch or None,subfolder or None); /tree/dev/src uses simple branch dev, subfolder src. Slash-containing branch names are unresolved; tests do not guess them.
- `build_file_tree(root,name,ignore,extensions)` -> deterministic tree string using 📂/📄 and box lines; ignores node_modules/generated directories and caller ignore predicate receiving pathlib.Path, extensions filter files. This rendering is an explicit proposed presentation convention.
- `analyze_dependencies(root)` -> (stack,Markdown details), reading requirements.txt or pyproject.toml project.dependencies; details identify the dependency file and contain its dependency entries; whitespace layout is not fixed. `is_text_file(path)` accepts UTF-8 including Turkish, rejects invalid UTF-8.
- `context_workflow.snapshot(url,extensions=...,line_limit=...,token=None,clone=...)` -> Markdown. Accept only HTTPS github.com URLs, nonnegative line limit (0 unlimited); clone(canonical_url,branch=...,token=...) returns an owned temporary checkout path. Ownership transfers to snapshot and it deletes that checkout after success/failure. Honor root .gitignore, selected subfolder/extensions, generated dirs; exclude .env* and all symlinks. Never follow escaping symlinks. Never print token. UTF-8 files in sorted order; truncated marker when necessary. Invalid URL -> ValueError before clone.
- `cli_snapshot(url,operation=...)` and `ui_snapshot(url,operation=...)` call the same injected operation and return identical Markdown. These are controller contracts; actual CLI/Streamlit event wiring still requires a manual end-to-end check.
Dependencies: Python, pytest, GitPython, gitignore-parser, TOML reader. No real cloning in tests; docs/UI integration remains separate.
- CLI/UI use context_workflow.snapshot through their common injected operation. Legacy adapters are outside this contract. Snapshot metadata identifies the canonical repository and branch; commit-hash rendering is not claimed by this interface.

Public imports:
- `context_workflow.cli_snapshot`

- `context_workflow.ui_snapshot`

```python
'Acceptance checks for observable application behavior.'

from repo_context.core import analyze_dependencies, build_file_tree, is_text_file, parse_github_url


def test_tree_filters_extensions_and_ignored_directories(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'main.py').write_text('print("hello")\n')
    (tmp_path / 'image.png').write_bytes(b'\x89PNG')
    hidden = tmp_path / 'node_modules'
    hidden.mkdir()
    (hidden / 'ignored.py').write_text('not project code')
    result = build_file_tree(tmp_path, 'demo', lambda path: False, ['.py'])
    assert result.splitlines()[0] == '📂 demo'
    assert 'main.py' in result
    assert 'image.png' not in result and 'ignored.py' not in result


def test_explicit_ignore_removes_matching_file(tmp_path):
    secret = tmp_path / 'private.py'
    secret.write_text('secret = "fixture only"')
    result=build_file_tree(tmp_path, 'demo', lambda path:path == secret, ['.py'])
    assert 'private.py' not in result
    assert result.splitlines() == ['📂 demo']


def test_requirements_are_included_in_dependency_context(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'requirements.txt').write_text('fastapi==0.115.0\npytest==8.4.2\n')
    stack, details = analyze_dependencies(tmp_path)
    assert stack == 'Python'
    assert 'requirements.txt' in details
    assert 'fastapi==0.115.0' in details and 'pytest==8.4.2' in details


def test_pyproject_dependencies_are_listed(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'pyproject.toml').write_text('[project]\ndependencies = ["httpx>=0.28", "pytest>=8"]\n')
    stack, details=analyze_dependencies(tmp_path)
    assert stack == 'Python'
    assert 'pyproject.toml' in details
    assert 'httpx>=0.28' in details and 'pytest>=8' in details


def test_branch_and_subdirectory_are_separated():
    assert parse_github_url('https://github.com/owner/project/tree/main/src/pkg/') == ('https://github.com/owner/project.git', 'main', 'src/pkg')


def test_utf8_file_is_recognized(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / 'notes.txt'
    path.write_text('Türkçe: ı İ ş')
    assert is_text_file(path) is True


def test_invalid_utf8_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / 'binary.bin'
    path.write_bytes(b'\xff\xfe\x00')
    assert is_text_file(path) is False


```

File: tests/test_workflow.py
```python
'Acceptance checks for observable application behavior.'
from unittest.mock import Mock
import pytest


def test_shared_operation_keeps_branch_subfolder_and_safe_file_scope(tmp_path):
    from context_workflow import snapshot
    checkout = tmp_path/'repo'
    (checkout/'src').mkdir(parents=True)
    (checkout/'src'/'main.py').write_text('first\nsecond\n')
    (checkout/'src'/'.env').write_text('API_KEY=fixture-secret')
    (checkout/'src'/'ignored.py').write_text('ignored-marker')
    (checkout/'.gitignore').write_text('src/ignored.py\n')
    (checkout/'elsewhere.py').write_text('outside-subfolder')
    (checkout/'src'/'escape.py').symlink_to(checkout/'elsewhere.py')
    clone = Mock(return_value=checkout)
    text = snapshot('https://github.com/a/b/tree/dev/src', extensions=['.py'],
                    line_limit=1, token='fixture-token', clone=clone)
    clone.assert_called_once_with('https://github.com/a/b.git', branch='dev', token='fixture-token')
    assert 'first' in text and 'second' not in text
    assert 'truncat' in text.lower()
    assert all(secret not in text for secret in ['fixture-secret','fixture-token','ignored-marker','outside-subfolder'])
    assert not checkout.exists()


def test_cli_and_ui_call_the_shared_operation():
    from context_workflow import cli_snapshot, ui_snapshot
    operation = Mock(return_value='fixture markdown')
    assert cli_snapshot('https://github.com/a/b', operation=operation) == 'fixture markdown'
    assert ui_snapshot('https://github.com/a/b', operation=operation) == 'fixture markdown'
    assert operation.call_args_list[0] == operation.call_args_list[1]
    assert operation.call_count == 2


def test_invalid_url_is_not_sent_to_clone():
    from context_workflow import snapshot
    clone = Mock()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        snapshot('file:///private', extensions=['.py'], line_limit=1, clone=clone)
    clone.assert_not_called()

def test_snapshot_sorts_files_and_excludes_binary_and_dependency_directories(tmp_path):
    from context_workflow import snapshot
    root=tmp_path/'checkout';root.mkdir()
    (root/'z.py').write_text('last_marker')
    (root/'a.py').write_text('first_marker')
    (root/'binary.py').write_bytes(b'\xff\xfe')
    (root/'node_modules').mkdir()
    (root/'node_modules'/'dependency.py').write_text('dependency_marker')
    text=snapshot('https://github.com/a/b',extensions=['.py'],line_limit=0,clone=Mock(return_value=root))
    assert text.index('first_marker') < text.index('last_marker')
    assert 'binary.py' not in text and 'dependency_marker' not in text
    assert not root.exists()

```
